principle: Frozen pre-2.0 evidence must be screened BEFORE new Research 2.0 direction. Artefacts are NOT independent experiments. Historic verdict tokens are untrusted navigation metadata; read exact source/audit before treating a result as established. Distinguish exact duplicate, bounded replication, new independent test, and unresolved prior.

findings.fact: Original 8.5x speed claim withdrawn: 2.822s cold vs 2.816s replay on matched three tasks, 1.002x; matched route saved novel decisions, not proven net runtime savings.
findings.guard: Always use matched tasks and fully loaded counterfactual costs; do not frame scripted replay as real-agent economics.

findings.fact: G-H2 reported 3/3 unseen compositions vs 0/3 cold/verbatim/single-shot BFS; keywords, oracle-guided stopping and weak baselines restrict inference.
findings.guard: Repeat only with controls that remove keyword/oracle and strong comparators; never present as broad generalization.

findings.fact: 901 true next-state transitions from 300 trajectories; rule DIM-ACC 0.6238, NN 0.6295, shuffle 0.5706, repeated trajectory holdouts; no website-holdout result.
findings.guard: Do not claim rule beats nearest-neighbour or transfers cross-site.

findings.topic: Web physics / next action / leakage / bootstrap
findings.fact: Prior physics headline invalid due to prev_action target leakage and Gaussian jitter mislabeled bootstrap.
findings.guard: Never inherit negative or positive scientific conclusion; require non-leaking prospective controls.

findings.fact: Follow-up verified no leakage on 875 rows and reports action-only MSE 0.756 vs full MSE 0.735; pre-state mechanics <3% additional explained variance at tested granularity.
findings.guard: Avoid rerunning near-identical state-feature tests; different observables may warrant new experiments.

findings.topic: task routes / compositionality / retrieval / semantic transfer
findings.fact: Among 176 evaluated routes, 6 exact human-route matches (3.41%), strict causal chains 4/176 (2.27%) and retrieval 47/176 (26.7%); extraction covered 3843/6766 actions.
findings.guard: Do not assume human-route imitation or exact cache replay suffices; distinguish retrieval, operation overlap and causal composition.

findings.fact: Immutable request identity, explicit write sets, hash-pinned inheritance, per-item recovery, separation of workflow completion and scientific validity.
findings.guard: Prevent repeated orchestration repairs from being treated as research advance.

decision_protocol: Search legacy index by subject/experiment/path before proposing a new experiment.
Inspect specific original archived source and audit for any matching evidence, including invalids; index verdict tokens are not authoritative.
In comparative_reasoning, explicitly classify LEGACY: DUPLICATE / REPLICATION / DISTINCT_EXTENSION / NO_MATCH / UNCERTAIN, with source sha or an honest unavailable-source explanation.
If duplicate without improved design/independent replication rationale, propose pivot or park rather than execute.
Keep frozen historical source separate from accepted Research 2.0 claim updates; never automatically promote legacy verdicts.
